title: DarkSeller carding / fullz marketplace and shadow-services forum
provider: VDSINA (AS216071, ex-Zservers) + GREEN FLOID / REG[.]RU / M247, Cloudflare-fronted
summary: DarkSeller is a live carding / fullz marketplace selling self-registered US bank accounts and SSNs, paired with a Russian-language 'Migalki' shadow-services forum. It is Cloudflare-fronted with backend and DNS spread across commodity and bulletproof-adjacent hosts; no malware/phishing feed flags it.
detail: Passive urlscan history (14 scans) shows the domain serving 'DarkSeller', a 'Realfullz[.]com - Self-Registered US Bank | SSN' storefront, and a Russian-language '✦ Migalki ✦' shadow-services forum. It is fronted by Cloudflare, with authoritative DNS (ns1/ns2) on 109[.]234[.]37[.]143 — announced by AS216071 (VDSINA), an ASN historically associated with the sanctioned host Zservers — and backend across GREEN FLOID/ITLDC, REG[.]RU and M247. VirusTotal (0/94), ThreatFox and URLhaus do not flag it, illustrating that carding-market infrastructure evades malware-C2 feeds; its nature was recovered from existing passive scan history.
